section: CR-003 FR-81 / ruling 4 — milestones on the requirement view
question: What should the milestone section on /requirements/[id] be called so it cannot be mistaken for a fifth FR-82 relationship?
best_guess: Heading 'Contract acceptance', data-verify-unit='requirement-acceptance' (not 'requirement-milestones'), with a note on the section saying it is FR-81's inbound side and not one of FR-82's four. Names only, never amounts.

section: §7a Prose — four states, five Wave C views
question: Where should the four-state Prose renderer live, given that five of Wave C's eight detail views render a Prose field and no unit owns src/components/?
best_guess: Keep it inside my own tree at src/app/requirements/_components/detail-prose.tsx and import it from the questions view; flag for consolidation into src/components/detail-prose.tsx after Wave C merges. Creating a file in src/components/ would collide with three other units doing the same thing in parallel.

section: §5a state scale — FR-47 self-certification on the tests section
question: FR-47 self-certification has no token of its own; engagement-coverage.tsx already draws its self-certified count in state-unproven (tone='warn'). Should the requirement view's per-test self-certified marker follow that, giving state-unproven two meanings?
best_guess: Follow the existing precedent exactly rather than introduce a token — the overload predates this unit and inventing a colour is the thing the brief forbids outright. Reported as an inherited overload rather than a new decision.

question: DetailSection only forwards verifyUnit, so a count cannot be published on the same element the e2e gate queries. Where should the four relationship counts go?
best_guess: One uniform child contract per section: data-verify-unit='relation-count' with data-verify-relation and data-verify-count, so all four counts answer one query and the gate's four section names stay exactly as asserted. No edit to entity-detail.tsx.

question: i1 measured that nothing in the product points at an open question (zero foreign keys, zero files under src/app/). Should /questions/[id] ship as a route reachable only by typing a uuid?
best_guess: Build it — FR-81 names open_question as one of the eight and gate test 2 enumerates all eight — and report the unreachability plainly rather than adding an unrequested listing screen to fix it.
